outcome.understand.clarificationBody: Your answer is recorded in the contract exactly as shown here.
outcome.understand.persistedNote: Every revision stays immutable and readable from the daemon.
outcome.understand.clarificationLocalDay: This Mac's local calendar day, resetting at local midnight
outcome.understand.immutableNote: Each save creates a new immutable revision.
outcome.understand.heading: State this Outcome
outcome.understand.conflictBody: Expected revision {{expected}}, but the current revision is {{current}}. Load the current contract to continue from it.
outcome.understand.retryableTitle: The daemon could not save the contract
outcome.understand.clarificationRolling: A rolling 24-hour window before each entry
outcome.decide.heading: Decide & authorize
outcome.decide.intro: Review exactly what the agent may do before anything runs. Nothing executes until you approve it.
outcome.decide.proposeBody: Waldo derives one direct work unit from your saved contract and freezes what the agent may do.
outcome.decide.approveNote: Approval activates these capability grants only inside this outcome's isolated worktree. Execution starts in the next stage.
outcome.decide.reviewWorkNote: Opens this Outcome's Act & Observe board, where you can start (or continue) the governed attempt.
outcome.decide.staleBody: This plan binds an older revision. Reload the current facts, then draft a fresh plan.
outcome.decide.blockedTitle: Not every capability is available here
outcome.decide.bindingNote: Frozen against contract revision {{contractRevision}}. Any material change requires a fresh plan.
outcome.run.heading: Act & observe
outcome.run.intro: One governed attempt at a time. Kennel shows the truthful state — waiting, working, unconfirmed, or ended — and completion is never treated as done.
outcome.run.needsPlanBody: Authorize a plan in Decide & Authorize first. Execution only ever starts from an approved plan.
outcome.run.startBody: Starting admits your approved plan onto a real provider session inside this outcome's isolated worktree. The attempt, its session identity, and every observation are recorded.
outcome.run.unconfirmedBody: The bound session has not proven it is alive. This is not declared dead — contain it, then reconcile before any replacement so duplicate effects stay impossible.
outcome.run.ownerStopBody: Kennel cannot prove whether the provider is still running. Continue only if YOU verified outside Kennel — process list, terminal, provider dashboard — that nothing is running. This releases custody on your word, records your assertion in the attempt history, and allows a replacement attempt.
outcome.run.ownerStopAssertCta: I verified it is stopped — release custody
outcome.run.waitingBody: Working — nothing needs you right now. Observations are recorded as they arrive.
outcome.run.unclassifiedBody: The provider session ended. Completion is not final acceptance — classification happens through Verification.
outcome.run.actionRequiredBody: This attempt could not be proven alive or ended in failure. Replace it with a fresh attempt; local work stays retained until explicit cleanup.
outcome.run.panelFallbackBody: Kennel doesn't have a live terminal for this attempt yet. This panel will show the real provider session once one is bound.
outcome.run.waitingInputBody: The provider asked for input — respond to its question in its session.
outcome.run.blockedBody: A permission/approval dialog blocks the provider — approve or deny it in its session.
outcome.run.cancelledBody: Cancellation is recorded and the bound session was stopped through the execution seam. Reconcile to confirm the stop and release custody before any replacement.
outcome.understand.clarificationTitle: One material question: what does “today” mean?
outcome.understand.constraintPlaceholder: A boundary the work must respect
outcome.understand.goalPlaceholder: What state does this Outcome pursue?

outcome.proof.decisionSummary: What did you decide, and why?
outcome.run.proofBody: Attempt completion is only a fact. Bind inspectable evidence to every criterion, record the real verification method, then make the owner decision.
